metas.name: 2 · ★ 7.3 · 1964 · A Shot in the Dark
metas.description: Bumbling Inspector Jacques Clouseau falls in love with murder suspect Maria Gambrelli and tries to clear her name.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 4.7 · 1968 · Inspector Clouseau
metas.description: A string of robberies has occurred in Britain and it's up to Inspector Clouseau to catch the criminal.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 7.0 · 1975 · The Return of the Pink Panther
metas.description: Inspector Jacques Clouseau is put on the case when the Pink Panther diamond is stolen, with the Phantom's trademark glove the only clue.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 7.1 · 1976 · The Pink Panther Strikes Again
metas.description: After escaping from an insane asylum, the bonkers Charles Dreyfus sends 26 assassins on the trail of the forever bumbling Inspector Clouseau.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 6.6 · 1978 · Revenge of the Pink Panther

metas.name: 7 · ★ 4.8 · 1982 · Trail of the Pink Panther
metas.description: Journalist Marie Jouvet attempts to uncover the mysterious disappearance of Chief Inspector Jacques Clouseau.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 4.4 · 1983 · Curse of the Pink Panther
metas.description: Ensuing after the events of Clouseau's disappearance, his bosses at the Surete put a computer into service to elect a new shrewd detective, Sleigh, who turns up just as inept as Clouseau.

metas.name: 9 · ★ 3.9 · 1993 · Son of the Pink Panther
metas.description: Charles Dreyfus encounters Jacques Gambrelli, who reminds him painfully of Inspector Clouseau, the man who drove him insane. With good reason: Gambrelli is Clouseau's son.

metas.name: 10 · ★ 5.7 · 2006 · The Pink Panther
metas.description: Bumbling Inspector Clouseau must solve the murder of a famous soccer coach and find out who stole the infamous Pink Panther diamond.

metas.name: 11 · ★ 5.6 · 2009 · The Pink Panther 2
metas.description: Insp. Jacques Clouseau teams up with a squad of International detectives who are just as bumbling as he is. Their mission: Stop a globe-trotting thief who specializes in stealing historical artifacts.
